data.narrativeText: The proposed business change involves onboarding QA corrected value, a Malta-based card settlement processor, which will have access to sensitive customer data including cardholder Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and settlement files. Given this processor's jurisdiction in Malta and the nature of the data access scope, there is an inherent risk related to the confidentiality and security of customer information, particularly involving retail cardholders and Money Services Business (MSB) merchants. The delivery channel for settlement processing will be through API without face-to-face contact, which aligns with categories of products and services identified in the FFIEC BSA/AML Manual as vulnerable to money laundering risks due to rapid movement of funds and limited physical interaction (Risks Associated with Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing - Products and Services).
